entries.subject: DAMIT 561: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-561.txt. Model 561, version 2013-02-11, pole (276°, 70°), period 16.68678 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 19.618 ±0.057 km. effective body diameter

entries.subject: Other DAMIT shape solutions
entries.finding: The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 562: pole (90°, 39°), 16.68678 h, version 2013-02-11. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent shape, spin or scale evidence distinguishes these alternatives, or a changed release offers a demonstrably better supported model.
